Definition: Data saved on a computer under a name, like story.txt.
A place on a computer that holds files and other folders. It is also called a directory.
The list of folders that leads to a file, like /Users/sam/Documents/story.txt.
The letters after the last dot in a file's name, like txt in story.txt. They hint at what kind of file it is.
A window that lets a person browse folders and pick a file or folder.
The main software that runs a computer, like Windows or macOS. It provides the file chooser window.
